discussion.body: Act 7 storyboard. Locations: Cannon loading city, barrel interior, Maze Fissure under the north massif. No new joins. Beats: Vortan fires or is one latch short because of Brann's book; dungeon one is the barrel; dungeon two is the Fissure; Velith, if alive, floods the Fissure with mist and feeds Nyxara; Nyxara; single ending. Ending always: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, six aspects rebound as well as they can, world standing and scarred. Present variations, not other endings: Bengenia already wiped or not; which main-side characters have graves; Velith dead, imprisoned, or gone in the wipe; Vortan dead or shackled; final fight uses clean or cracked Sigils. Cael and Liraen live. Suggestive romance beat is available on the Light-scarred south horizon after the seal. Frames: loading city, barrel, fissure mouth, Nyxara, seal, quiet road.
